_comment: Optional MCP connectors for the video production assistant. None is required. setup_connectors.py merges the ones you choose into an MCP config file. No secrets belong in this file.

elevenlabs.title: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs.adds: Scribe transcripts, voice isolation, music, sound effects, text-to-speech
elevenlabs.cost: Paid credits (small free tier). The assistant asks before every use.
elevenlabs.needs: uv (uvx) installed; ELEVENLABS_API_KEY set in your environment

vidiq.title: vidIQ
vidiq.adds: YouTube keyword research, outlier videos, competitor stats, transcripts, monthly review
vidiq.cost: vidIQ plan credits; your plan must include MCP access.
vidiq.needs: A vidIQ account. You sign in through the browser on first use.

desktop-commander.title: Desktop Commander (shell connector)
desktop-commander.adds: Lets a chat-only agent run commands and edit files on your computer
desktop-commander.needs: Node.js. Skip it if your agent already has a shell.

hyperframes.title: HyperFrames by HeyGen (hosted)
hyperframes.adds: Shareable HeyGen video project rendered in the cloud
hyperframes.needs: Add it by name from your agent's connector directory and sign in. No config entry is written. The free local CLI (npx hyperframes) needs no connector.
